meaning.zh:
“艰难的任务” 或 “难以实现的请求”。

这个短语的起源可以追溯到19世纪末。原本是一个体育术语，用来描述那些非常高难度的任务或要求。随着时间的推移，"tall order" 被广泛应用于各种场合，形容那些超过常规难度的任务或请求。
meaning.en: This phrase can be traced back to the late 19th century and was originally a sports term used to describe particularly challenging tasks or demands. Over time, "tall order" has come to be used in general contexts to refer to tasks or requests that are exceptionally difficult.

lines.en: Convincing him to change his mind is a tall order.
lines.zh: 要说服他改变主意是一个艰难的任务。

lines.en: Finishing this project by next week is a tall order.
lines.zh: 要在下周之前完成这个项目是一个难以实现的请求。

lines.en: Getting everyone to agree on the new plan will be a tall order.
lines.zh: 要让所有人都同意这个新计划将会是一个艰难的任务。
